And, of course, the earth adepts are those who inhabit some of these fabled mythic places, which are sometimes very real, like Shambhala, for example, which is the seat of the Lord of the world. Or there's a temple of Ibez in the Mato Grosso of Brazil, which was the first outpost of hierarchy, the adepts, beyond the one at Shambhala. And then there was the Trans-Somalian Lodge, which was seated, when we last heard about it, in or near Shigatse in Tibet. Are these physical places? (0:24:34)

Yes. The three I've mentioned are or were. That is to say, Shambhala as a physical place is now in ruins under the Gobi Desert. But as what we would call a, if you like, finer matter reality, it's still in what they would call the physical dimension, but it's in a state of matter which is finer than that that we're normally cognizant of. (0:25:01)

After all, we are only familiar with gases, liquids, and solids. But they would tell us that there are four levels of physical matter beyond that. And I understand that scientists are now rediscovering something they call quark-gluon plasma, which is a new title for the old ether we heard about in the old days. So they, in a sense, are giving some support to the notion that finer matter exists. (0:25:23)

Yes. Now, let's jump a bit, if we may, to the realm of angelic beings. I think traditionally in theology, angels are considered to be messengers of God. It's a beatific realm. They live in bliss and joy. And they don't get the kind of fast feedback we get here when we bump our head or stub our toe. It's a slower evolutionary process. (0:25:51)

It's mainly one of, what shall we say, intermediary energy transmission. That is to say, you see them presiding behind the scenes at the Eucharist and churches, or looking after the recovery of patients in the hospitals, or looking after the energy transmission to life forms in some particular realm, like, say, all that pertains to the sea. (0:26:27)

They can be very, very large and advanced, or they can be very immediate and quite human, depending on the rank that they hold. It was an experience that I wasn't expecting. But when it burst upon me, it was a revelation, and it's been a delight ever since. Donald, we just have a few minutes left, and you've been speaking with a sense of real familiarity about realms that most people only read about in childhood, usually. (0:27:02)

I think it might be important to conclude our interview with a discussion of some of the pitfalls involved for people who are to engage in the kind of explorations that have been your lifelong pursuit. Well, there are many pitfalls. One might come under the heading of gullibility. Don't know, don't take it for certain that you have such and such an individual on the line, unless you have become sensitive enough to register the qualitative nature or characteristics of that individuality. If you don't know, you better check with people who do know. (0:27:38)

One would be, again, being taken in by receiving messages which are maybe a little ego-inflating and engaging, but then may turn out to be someone who's posing as somebody else. What other direction would you like to go in? Well, we're just about out of time, but you seem to be suggesting, and we hardly touched on it, that there is a realm comparable to what you've described. (0:28:13)

What has been called demonic in some of the traditions. Yes. A place where there are some real serious pitfalls. All right. There have certainly been dark magicians. The worst of them have been pretty well set aside now. They've had to choose upsides recently. Unfortunately, Donald, we've got no more time to pursue this fascinating discussion, but I'm really delighted to have you here with me to share this. Thanks so much for being with me. (0:28:41)

You're most welcome. And thank you for being with us. Book three in the New Thinking Allowed dialogue series is UFOs and UAP. Are We Really Alone? Now available on Amazon. New Thinking Allowed is presented by the California Institute for Human Science, a fully accredited university offering distant learning graduate degrees that focus on mind, body, and spirit. (0:29:27)

The topics that we cover here, we are particularly excited to announce new degrees emphasizing parapsychology and the paranormal. Visit their website at cihs.edu. You can now download a free PDF copy of issue number eight of the New Thinking Allowed magazine or order a beautiful printed copy. Go to newthinkingallowed.org. (0:29:52)

(2025-04-29)

item.title: Sebastien Martin の証言: 闇鍋的な多種多様な contactee 体験の具体例
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

セバスチャン・マルティンはフランス生まれのカナダ人シリアル起業家です。彼はほぼ20年にわたり、マヌカハニーを軸にした国際的な健康食品会社を築き上げ、アメリカ、カナダ、イギリス、ニュージーランドにオフィスを構えています。2011年11月、セバスチャンは第5種接近遭遇を経験しました。接近遭遇には様々な種類がありますが、今日はその中でも特に重要な体験についてお話しします。彼は第5次元の実在する存在と接触し、以来、その存在や彼の星の家族との通信を続けています。頻繁で強力なメッセージを受け取り、意識の向上を目的とした情報を受け取っています。 （0:01:19）

このような衝撃的な経験は、セバスチャンを催眠療法のサービスに頼るように迫りました。これは、明らかに人生を変えるような遭遇から生じた問題や、幼少期から抱えてきた予言的なビジョンに対処するためです。 現在、彼は『Cosmic Disclosure』に出演し、リモートビューワーとして活動しています。銀河同盟とアジェンダに精通しており、ETコンタクトEの資格を持ち、分裂した魂、 人間の意識、そしてはるかに多くのことを知っています。最近の訪問では11次元存在と接触し、並行タイムラインに関する信念が強化され、大天使と出会った経験もしています。クンダリーニ覚醒体験と最初の遭遇以来、毎日強力なダウンロードを受け、超常的な能力が強化されています。彼はリモートビューイングの分野で働き、多くの異なる組織、多くの異なる... アルファベット機関とも関わり、おそらく高い機密保持資格を有し、秘密の宇宙プログラム、スターゲート、エイリアン・アジェンダと何らかの形でつながっています。彼の著書は『The Inner Journey in Outer Space』で、私は最近数日で読みましたが、素晴らしい内容です。Sébastien MartineをGuys Guys Radioに初めてお迎えでき、大変光栄です。ようこそ、Sébastien。ありがとうございます、ロバート。素晴らしい紹介でした。本当に感謝しています。 （0:02:42）

といった闇鍋的な多種多様の体験を証言している。異常心理の参考事例としても役立つかも。

展開

Sebastian Martine is a Canadian serial entrepreneur born in France. He's built an international health foods company, a lot of it based around Manuka honey, for almost two decades, offices in the US, Canada, UK, New Zealand. In November of 2011, Sebastian had a close encounter of the fifth kind, and they're all different kinds of close encounters, and we'll talk about that today, but with a stellar being living in a fifth dimension reality, and he has had communications with him and the rest of his star family ever since, receiving frequent and powerful downloads, all aimed to raise consciousness. (0:01:19)

This type of disturbing experience forced Sebastian to resort to the services of hypnotherapy to help him with some of the issues arising from what could be obviously a life-changing encounter, and as well as the prophetic visions he's had since he's a kid. Now, he's been on Cosmic Disclosure, he is a remote viewer, he is familiar with the Galactic Alliance and Agenda, he's an ET, Contact E, he knows all about split souls, human consciousness, and much, much more, and his most recent visits involved 11th dimensional beings, reinforced his belief, and clarified in terms of parallel timelines, he's even met with archangels, and he gets powerful downloads every day after his Kundalini awakening experience and his first encounter, and this enhances psychic abilities, and he works in the field of remote viewing, and he does work for a lot of different organizations, a lot of different... the Alphabet organizations, he has, I'm sure, a high security clearance, he's connected somehow to the Secret Space Program, Stargates, and the Alien Agenda, his book is called The Inner Journey in Outer Space, I read it over the last few days, it's fantastic, it's my delight and honor to welcome Sébastien Martine to Guys Guys Radio for the first time, welcome Sébastien. Well, thank you Robert for having me, it was a great introduction, thank you so much. (0:02:42)

Youtube 動画(43:27)​

ET Disclosure, Remote Viewing

FasterWhisper AI(large-v2 model)​

展開

Imagine being able to witness events from the past, the present, and even the future. This is Robert Manny, host of GuysGuysTV, and this week my special guest is Sebastian Martine, remote viewer. It all starts right here, right now, on GuysGuysTV. You can also catch me on KCAA Radio here in Southern California, GuysGuysRadio, my worldwide podcast, and we're on UK Health Radio all weekend long. (0:00:24)

GuysGuysTV, GuysGuysRadio, thanks for your support. Okay, GuysGuysRadio, it is the interview portion of our show, and I'm delighted to introduce a new guest to GuysGuysRadio. Sebastian Martine is a Canadian serial entrepreneur born in France. He's built an international health foods company, a lot of it based around Manuka honey, for almost two decades, offices in the US, Canada, UK, New Zealand. In November of 2011, Sebastian had a close encounter of the fifth kind, and they're all different kinds of close encounters, and we'll talk about that today, but with a stellar being living in a fifth dimension reality, and he has had communications with him and the rest of his star family ever since, receiving frequent and powerful downloads, all aimed to raise consciousness. (0:01:19)

This type of disturbing experience forced Sebastian to resort to the services of hypnotherapy to help him with some of the issues arising from what could be obviously a life-changing encounter, and as well as the prophetic visions he's had since he's a kid. Now, he's been on Cosmic Disclosure, he is a remote viewer, he is familiar with the Galactic Alliance and Agenda, he's an ET, Contact E, he knows all about split souls, human consciousness, and much, much more, and his most recent visits involved 11th dimensional beings, reinforced his belief, and clarified in terms of parallel timelines, he's even met with archangels, and he gets powerful downloads every day after his Kundalini awakening experience and his first encounter, and this enhances psychic abilities, and he works in the field of remote viewing, and he does work for a lot of different organizations, a lot of different... the Alphabet organizations, he has, I'm sure, a high security clearance, he's connected somehow to the Secret Space Program, Stargates, and the Alien Agenda, his book is called The Inner Journey in Outer Space, I read it over the last few days, it's fantastic, it's my delight and honor to welcome Sébastien Martine to Guys Guys Radio for the first time, welcome Sébastien. Well, thank you Robert for having me, it was a great introduction, thank you so much. (0:02:42)

Well, I gotta tell you, you have an incredible life story, I mean, so many different things, you were a regular kid in many ways, but you had extraordinary experiences, and a very tough birth, so tell us about how you got into the whole metaphysical area, starting from the very beginning, what happened when you were a child, you had Lennier's disease, you had family issues, you had astral travel issues, you learned about the silver cord, you had your accident, you had bilocation issues, tell everybody a little bit about who are you and what you're all about. (0:03:15)

Well, if I have to sum up my book, it's complicated in 40 minutes, but I have to say that when I was growing up, I had those events, you know, here and there, I had an unusual childhood in the extent that when I was born, I was missing the first layer of my epidermis, so I was born raw, my skin was red and I was in pain, I was screaming every day for six months of my life, and doctors could not figure out what was wrong with me, and I've seen many doctors in Europe, and they had no clue, so they kind of tagged me with a natural disease that was called Lennier's mousse, and that disease is a very rare genetic disorder that affects hundreds of thousands of kids around the world, but specifically those children who are affected by this disease will end up to be five feet tall and very skinny, and have lots of health issues associated with it. That was not my case. (0:04:20)

After six months, my skin started to grow, and I became like a normal child, you know, per se. (0:04:29)

Even if I had some respiratory issues at the beginning, my parents sent me off to the Pyrenees Mountains to heal, and I was away from them for six months of my life, and then I came back and, you know, I never had asthma ever since. So I have to say that growing up, I didn't feel any different than anybody else. I was living in an older home, so I was always subjected to sea spirits in that house all the time, but I never really mentioned it to my family. I was just observing those silhouettes passing through the house. (0:05:06)

It never really, truly scared me when I was in the living room, for example, watching TV. I just knew that if I just stayed where I was, you know, those spirits would not disturb me, and so I was not going to meet with them to venture in their space. I was staying away, but I was living with it. It was kind of an odd thing, but that's what I was used to. (0:05:28)

And as I was growing up, again, I became older. I remember having those déjà-vu experiences where I was looking outside, and I said, oh, I already lived that experience before. That could be explained scientifically, obviously, like with your eyelids just flapping a few times too fast, and then you just think that you already lived that experience. I don't know, but when my life truly changed is when I went off to a boarding school when I was about 14 years old, and then I started to have those very vivid dreams, and I experienced my first out-of-body experiences at that point. (0:06:12)

I could literally see my hands, and I was in full control of my body, so having the full-blown astral experience and seeing my silver cord go into space and being fully aware of that experience and that connection. And I knew that if I wanted to go back into my physical body, it would be like in a fraction of a second I'd be back in my body, so I felt safe. And I remember at the time I used to talk to this nurse at school because I used to have pounding headaches. (0:06:45)

I used to have lots of physical effects from those experiences as well. And so as I was seeing that nurse at school, I had nosebleeds as well and everything else, and so I was asking her, do you know if I'm going out of my body? And that nurse was quite something, I have to say. (0:07:14)

She had two different eye colors, so I thought that she was very unique in that aspect, like David Bowie. And she was fully aware of astral travel and out-of-body experiences. She was really into it. And so when I told her that I went into space and I felt excited about discovering other planets and these sort of things, and she was warning me, saying, you have to be careful because if you venture too far out and then there's a dark spirit, for example, that could just cut off your silver cord, then you'll be disconnected from your body and you might turn insane or something really bad happened to you. (0:07:49)

I wasn't aware of that. I wasn't aware of any kind of protections and anything to do with my own safety at the time. (0:07:57)

And I just carried on my life as usual. I didn't really have those experiences again often, but flying into my dreams was a common fact for me. I always used to remember those things. And then when it truly changed for me was when I actually liked a girl in that school and I wanted to impress her. And I really don't know why. And this is, I guess, the big question. How did I know? (0:08:33)

I was doing transcendental meditation. My mom introduced me to it when I was very young, like eight years old or something. And so I was practicing transcendental meditation, usually sitting down, repeating my mantras and doing that pretty much daily. And so for me to use transcendental meditation in a different manner was very unusual to me. So when I liked that girl and I said, you know, let's do an experiment. And again, I have no idea how, why I even thought of this. (0:09:07)

I said, how about you place an object on your nightstand tonight? Because she was in a border as well, like me. And so I said, put an object on your nightstand and tomorrow morning I will tell you what it is. Just a way for me to try to impress her, which was kind of dumb actually. And then I went back into my own bedroom and then I decided to lie down and use transcendental meditation techniques lying down and starting with my mantra. (0:09:40)

And all of a sudden I could see myself very quickly. My eyes were closed and I could see myself going in a tunnel, like a dark tunnel, going very fast. And then I was hovering with my... so this is when I've used my third eye for the first time really, was I was hovering over this nightstand looking at three objects. And so I was able to describe those objects. They were in full color. They were very clear to me. (0:10:08)

I couldn't see anything else. And as soon as I saw those objects, I just remember going back through that tunnel and waking up and opening up my eyes. And I was like in a panic because I could no longer move. I was in sweats. I was out of breath and I could not get out of my bed and that panicked me. And I've always promised myself that I would never do that again. But I was very happy because I was able to achieve what I was planning to do. (0:10:36)

So the next day I went to see that girl and I said, look, you know, I saw three objects. You try to trick me. And it was not just one. And she turned blank, like she was white as a ghost. And she would not discuss that ever again. For another few years when I, as an adult, I reached out to her, we're still in touch as friends. And then I asked her, I said, you know, why were you so scared? (0:11:01)

And she said to me, well, because one of the objects that you described was a pendant that my dad gave me before he passed away in a car crash. (0:11:10)

And I never wore it at school. So I knew that you saw something real. And the way you described it scared me because she was a devout Catholic. And so that was basically something that really spooked her. And it was a topic that she didn't want to talk about because to her, it was maybe like satanic or something of the... something she could not understand, basically. And, but I was, I was, you know, able to describe these other two objects. And she was able many years later to tell me that I was right. (0:11:42)

I never had a confirmation then when I was doing it with her. So a few years went by and then when I was about 16 years old, still in the same school, I was in a class, Spanish class. And it was, there was, we had two hours of Spanish class. So I was, during the break, after the first hour, and then during that break, I had a vision. (0:12:09)

I saw one of my classmates being hit by a car, you know, outside school. So I knew exactly the location. That was my first, I would say, vision or prophetic vision that I had. And that spooked me. But at the same time, I didn't know what to do with it, because it was so new. And I felt like I had to warn her. So I wrote it down on a piece of paper, put it into a pen case. (0:12:36)

And then after the break, she went back into the class and she opened up a pen case. She saw the note and then she said, like, you know, who did this? So it was just before the second hour of the Spanish class started. So she was like yelling in the classroom saying, you know, who did this? It's not funny. And so I said, it's me. (0:12:56)

And so she wasn't happy with me. And then she had all of her friends with her and they were like looking at me with like dirty looks and these sort of things. And, you know, this kind of went away, you know, and then the year later. So basically, we're in the same class year after year. And then the next year, she didn't show up. And so I asked her friends, I said, what happened? (0:13:18)

And Rachel was her name. And this, she said, well, you know, she had an accident. And the accident was actually caused by the Spanish teacher in the class I was in. So he was the one who hit her on a scooter. And I saw her dead in my vision. But she didn't die. She became paraplegic. And so she was in a wheelchair for the rest of her life. (0:13:45)

Oh my goodness. Wow. But that was kind of shocking. And that's when I realized that the visions became real. But at the same time, her friends looked at me like I was a weirdo, or they were like spooked by me because of what I was able to see. (0:14:00)

Okay. Sebastian Martine, amazing story. My special guest on this week's Guys Guys Radio. So you were remote viewing and you mentioned TM. I also practice TM. And I did it this morning before our conversation. And what I noticed was, over time, I started to clear out. I felt that I've been remote viewing while in TM, where I go to places, I just let it happen. (0:14:23)

And I don't know if this is part of TM or not, but I've gone to places and I'm literally there. And it's usually in the past. And I have to kind of witness situations and it kind of dissolves them and dissolves any blockages or anything like that. So that's kind of, I guess, a natural form of remote viewing. I also took some classes with Laurie Williams, who is a protege of Lynn Buchanan, and it's all mathematical with the symbols and all of that. (0:14:49)

Did you ever take any formal courses for your remote viewing or is it all been kind of organic for you? It's been very organic. In fact, I didn't know what I was doing at the time was remote viewing when I was asked. So now we have to move a bit forward. Please. When I started becoming vocal about my experiences, so I had like an IT encounter and I had past life regressions and all of that. And I was discussing all of these experiences on the radio. (0:15:19)

And so at the time, I was still part of that business that I've started as a founder. I was a CEO and became chairman for two years. And then I had to resign from my chairman of the board's position in order to do my interviews, because it would have been potentially conflicting with the other members of the organization. So I was OK with that. And then I started talking about my experiences. I felt like I had to convey my message and share it with as many people as possible at the time. (0:15:52)

And I was having those visions, very vivid visions, which were very scary to me at the time. It was like seeing earthquakes and tsunamis and cataclysms of all sorts and plane crashes, you name it. And I was living those experiences as a first person. I was always embodying someone else. I was not myself, per se. I was living in the body of someone else. (0:16:22)

Any positive things? It sounds like a lot of these things are like natural disasters and things like that. Yes, of course. I saw my son, my daughter in the future as well. So I had some very positive visions. In fact, I knew the sex of my children before they were born. I already knew where they were going to be and how they were going to look like. So that was very comforting to my wife at the time when I was pregnant. (0:16:52)

And it was something she was happy to hear because it was not negative, but she had witnessed as well my other visions, which were pretty dramatic. (0:17:04)

She didn't know what to do with it at the time, and I didn't know what to do with it at the time because I was panicked and I was stressed out by it. So because they were becoming so frequent, I had to resort to see a clinical hypnotherapist to deal with my visions. And my sole goal was to try to get rid of them. And so when I started becoming vocal about all of what I've learned from those sessions, I attracted the attention of some alphabet agencies who basically followed me on my Facebook page, but without interacting with me. (0:17:45)

And the reason being is because I mentioned one event, one of those visions, which again was through the eyes of someone else. I was looking at a man in a car through a scope. I was on the rooftop, and I could clearly see the man opening up his window, and that's when I saw his face. And right away, when I saw that, the vision stopped. (0:18:10)

And what I heard... so when you are like, let's say a clairvoyant, and you see something from the past or the future, you can see things. I saw everything I see through like a mini movie, always. It's never like a still image. It's always a mini movie. But I'm also hearing, so I'm a clairvoyant and clairaudience, so I can hear. And what I hear is usually very specific keywords or words or sentences that are to do with that event. And at that moment, I heard Prime Minister assassinated. (0:18:46)

So I was very curious because I did not recognize the man I was seeing on my vision. So I went on Google Images, and that's when I searched Prime Minister assassinated. And that's when I saw Rafik Hariri's face, who was the Prime Minister of Lebanon many years ago, and he was killed in a car in Lebanon. And I had no idea why I was seeing this because this event occurred seven years prior. (0:19:15)

So he died seven years ago when I had that vision. So it made no sense to me as to why I was seeing it. But the details that I was describing on the radio shows were not known to the press. And therefore, that's the reason why those alphabet agencies were curious to put me as a person of interest, because I knew something that no one else knew. (0:19:41)

So they were curious to know who I was. And so they were basically just following me around. So it started off with Facebook. And I don't think I even wrote it in my book, but I had some vans. I don't know if I wrote it or not. I forgot now. But I had a white van coming into my property as well. And I had a vision of that too. So that same night, I clearly saw the van coming into my property at the time I was sleeping. But I could see there was snow outside. And I was so curious that I had to go outside and look at the road. (0:20:18)

And there's a specific road on my property. I had a commercial property that was very steep. And in the wintertime, we were not using it because it was too steep and cars and trucks would just get caught in the ice maybe and have an accident. So we never used it in the winter. But that day, there were tracks on the road. Like truck tracks. And they were very clearly defined and were in and out. (0:20:43)

And I don't know, again, what happened, who came over to see me. But the vision I had, which was an interesting one, I was traveling through the corridor of my house. So I was in bed. And I could clearly see, remember, going in the middle of the night, traveling through. And the van was parked right outside my house. I had a glass door for my entryway. And I could see two men, two occupants in that van. (0:21:09)

And the man got spooked because somehow, he saw me. I don't know exactly what happened. I don't believe they were regular men. I do believe they were probably men in black. And the clear indication I had from them that they were hybrids themselves. So I knew, I recognized that from them. So we're not normal human beings. (0:21:35)

By hybrid, just for our audience, you mean what? They were like a mix of human beings and ET origins. So they were manipulated to be special, different than regular human beings. They look somewhat human, but they're not quite human. So they can drive vans, they could fool anybody walking on the streets to be like normal people, but they are not standard human beings. (0:22:02)

Okay, Sebastian, let me ask you about remote viewing just for our audience, those who aren't familiar with it. So remote viewing is you can they kind of a perfect example would be, I think, the remote viewer located Saddam Hussein and found that he was like hiding in a hole someplace. And that's how they found him. So it's a practice of seeing things, whether it's in the past or the future or the present, where you can use a formula, or you may have an organic gift like yourself, where you can actually see other places. (0:22:31)

Talk to us a little bit about how that works. And do you look at things in the past? Because I know you've had these visions of the past? Or is it more in the future? How is your skill deployed? And how does it do you ever see other people? If you go someplace? Can you find other remote viewers already there? And can they see you? And do you have to kind of like peel off and leave? How does that all work? (0:22:52)

Yes, so I'm kind of chucking at that, because I had an experience like this, but it was not with a human being. However, the the remote viewing I've experienced, again, I didn't know what was remote viewing when I first experienced it. When I was remote viewing, this agent was following me on Facebook, I connected to that person, and was able to save her life because her life was in danger. (0:23:22)

And she was in Iraq at the time. And I said, your life is in danger. And I described what was going on. And so based on that event, that was already remote viewing, it was not just a regular vision, I was, you know, seeing the event through our eyes. And that's usually what I do when I remote view. What incited that? What incited that, Sébastien? How did you click onto that? Did she ask you? Or did you just knew that something was happening? (0:23:47)

No, I just knew. I just knew intuitively that this was out of the thousands of people I had on Facebook at the time. When I first did my interviews, I was not selecting anybody, I was just like randomly accepting any requests that was coming in through my Facebook. So I was not selective. And I didn't know most of the people that were going on to my Facebook. But somehow, I just knew out of the thousands of people I had on Facebook that this was the person I had visions of. So I reached out to her by messenger. And I said, you know, your life is in danger. I know what you do. And you need to get out. And so she she got out, but she didn't reach out to me for another four weeks. (0:24:29)

And then at the time she was in Jordan, and she sent me a picture of a man I described as part of my vision of people walking through the crowd. And those three men, one of them was working for the Iraqi government. And a safe house was actually seen by those guys, they knew that they were actually aiming to, you know, arrest her basically. But she was able to escape and leave the country without problems. (0:24:57)

And so she was the one who trained me to become a remote viewer by testing me through newspaper articles. And she was explaining to me, so what you are doing is remote viewing. And she never tried to give me a protocol or anything else like that. She just like, send me random newspaper articles. And she asked me to read the articles, which were foreign to me. They were all in English, and I had to tell her what I picked up from those articles. (0:25:26)

And as I was reading those articles, I was able to know the truth about those people. So for example, there were two women who passed away. They apparently committed suicide, jumping off a building in Jordan, and then they died. (0:25:42)

And the article just explained that they committed joint suicide. And I knew it was not suicide, I think they just got pushed. And I saw two soldiers in that vision. One left from the back of that building in construction, and the other one left on the front. And the response I got from that agent was, well, that's interesting. We knew of one soldier, not two. So she was validating my remote viewing experiences when I was doing it live. So for me, when I was seeing something, I knew this was in the past. But when I do remote viewing, I don't have to concentrate to be isolated. (0:26:26)

I could just be cooking my eggs in the kitchen and having a full blown vision if I'm asked to do something. It comes organically. So if I asked you, okay, what am I going to be doing three years from now? You could lock into that? Potentially, but not like this. It doesn't work that way. For me, I had a direct connection to that agent. And we've been working together for almost a decade now. So it's been ongoing. And I was always very good at seeing events through her or connected to her for whatever she was involved in. (0:27:04)

I saved her life three times. It doesn't mean that I can do this for everybody else that I don't know, randomly. I need to have a point of connection. And I do this with friends, for example, where my friends would reach out to me and say, look, I have this friend in Mexico, for example, who has a daughter and they're having major conflicts with each other. (0:27:27)

And so he gave me two pictures, one of the mother and one of the daughter. And just by looking at the pictures, I was able to read the energy and knew exactly what was the conflict and how to solve it. Wow. You're like multidimensional. And the story, forgive me for interrupting, but the story gets even bigger than this, because not only that, you have been visited by kind of your starseed family, intergalactic 11th dimensional beings who came and told you why you're here and why you're doing what you're doing and what your mission is. I want to get to that. (0:28:05)

Also, you've met with Archangels, but let's start with your starseed family. What happened there? So that came on November 2011, when I had a regular night dream, waking up, remembering this being who basically looked like a human being, but with bigger eyes, higher cheekbones. And he was very happy to see me. He had this unusual bright smile that was forced. It wasn't so much forced, but you could see it was not natural. He was trying his best to look natural, but it was not a natural smile. (0:28:44)

And that kind of shocked me because I knew that being was not human based on the eyes and everything else. And so it kind of stayed with me, that vision stayed with me for the whole day. And that day, it was a day off. So my employees were away, but I went to the office to catch up with some work. (0:29:02)

So I went into my office, and then through the window of my office, I could still see that being, basically still in my field of vision. And it was with me for the whole day. And I didn't know why. Usually when you dream of something, you just shake it off and it's gone. But this being stayed with me for the whole day, entire day. (0:29:22)

So when it was time to go for dinner, I went back home. And after dinner, I said to my wife, I said, look, I'm just going to stay on the sofa and I need to just like rest by myself. And so she went to bed with our daughter at the time. And I basically stayed on the sofa, poured myself a chamomile tea, which was sipping on the counter in the kitchen. (0:29:47)

And I started to close my eyes. And I was like meditating. I was trying to understand what was happening to me. And as I did that, within a few seconds, I could still feel this whirlwind of energy, like going all around me. And I could feel it. It was a very, very intense energy. And then I could not understand what it was. It was unique. And when the energy stopped, I opened my eyes and I could see that being standing up right in front of me. The same being that appeared in my dreams in the morning. But he was physically standing up right in front of me, in front of my library. I had like a few shelves next to the TV. And he was covering the whole thing. He was there physically. He appeared physical to me. (0:30:36)

But he was not. He was an hologram. And it took me years to realize that, actually. But when I first saw him, my first bodily response was trying to stand up and fight him. Because I was there to protect my family. I wasn't thinking rationally. How tall was he? He wasn't that tall. I would say probably the same height as me. Maybe a bit taller. Like 6'3", maybe. (0:30:59)

Okay. And when I saw him, my first reaction was trying to get up. And I couldn't move. I was frozen. And it kind of made me panic a bit. Because I wanted to react, but I couldn't speak either. Because my first thought was, what are you doing in my house? And these sort of things. I could not speak. I could only think it. (0:31:20)

And as I was thinking all of this, he was still looking at me with the same unusual bright smile that he had in my vision. And he never changed. Never phased from that look. Always stayed the same. And he basically told me telepathically that his name was Zoar. Z-O-A-R. From the Galactic Alliance. And that I had no fear to have. That he was not there to hurt me or harm me. (0:31:49)

And again, we felt like we had a conversation. And at the time, I remember having those questions to do with cataclysms and these sort of things. Because it was still ongoing for me. I was still in that mode. And I was waiting for my appointment with a clinical hypnotherapist. (0:32:09)

So for me, everything was happening at the same time. And my first questions to him was about the cataclysms. And he said, oh yeah, these will happen. And lots of people will die. But that's no big deal. We live forever anyway. Our souls live on. And he was not phased by it. But that panicked me. Because for me, it was so new. And I was not really familiar with ETs. And I knew nothing of this world. This was not my thing. (0:32:38)

I was a businessman. I was there to make money. And that's what I cared about. That was my life. So for me, when I had that experience, I didn't know how long the conversation went. And I don't fully remember what we discussed. Because I had a blank. All I remember was him leaving and he phased out. His whole body phased out. He stuck with you though, right? And you met him and some of his friends, right? (0:33:07)

No, no. He had a blue glow of energy around him. And then he went away. He vanished. He was not with his friends. But you've seen him again since then? I have seen him again, yes. But that was later, like years after that. But this time around, when I saw him and he vanished, I just stood up. And I thought I lost my mind. Because I really thought I turned crazy. (0:33:31)

And I was walking back to the kitchen to grab my cup of tea. And I was still looking down the floor, still thinking about what just happened. I was shocked. And so I grabbed the tea, put it to my lips. And then I saw it was freezing cold. And then I looked at the clock on the stove and I had two hours of missing time. And I didn't think that so much time went through or went by. (0:33:58)

Give me one second. Sorry. Sorry, I dropped something. Okay. It's all right. So I was shocked. And I was wondering what happened. Like, I don't remember a thing. I only remember some of it, but not all of it. And so that was my experience with Zorro. And I didn't know who he was. I didn't know where he came from. I came to realize down the line that he was a Pleiadian. I call him my star family because when I did the sessions with the hypnotherapist, I was able to revisit my abductions. (0:34:38)

And so when I was with the hypnotherapist, I didn't know. I really didn't know I was abducted or contactee of any kind, because for me, it never crossed my mind. Even when I was at school, when I was 16 years old and I was writing pages and pages of this alien language, I was obsessed with it. And I was writing from top to bottom, left to right. (0:35:05)

And I was writing almost like, not hieroglyphs, but almost like Chinese, you know, signs, like basically like pages on end. I had like notebooks of it. (0:35:15)

And I didn't know. I was obsessed. I was just writing and writing and writing that language that I couldn't understand. But I never questioned it at the time. So what did they tell you your mission was? So when I was regressed and I saw my family through regression, they told me that all I was supposed to be doing was living my life and die. (0:35:41)

So just to feel and have all the human emotions that we normally have. And they were learning from that. And I couldn't understand why. Because to me, they probably had emotions like human beings did, but I wasn't really questioning it. But that's what they told me. And my stepfather basically said to me, I said, since you're now awake, your mission is to awaken the starseeds of this planet. (0:36:09)

He did not tell me how. He didn't try to give me a manual and tell me exactly what to do. So from that experience, I thought, well, maybe I should just do interviews and share my information with people. And maybe I was pushed as well by lots of friends to write a book and to share my experiences with them. And that's what I did. (0:36:30)

But apart from that, I had other friends telling me, oh, you should start a center and start teaching people. You know, I never really thought of that because to me, that was enough. And I didn't really see myself as a guru or like a leader of any kind or spiritual leader. I certainly didn't want to have this cult of personality. So I stayed away from all of that. (0:36:56)

I just saw, you know, my bit was to share my experiences on radio shows, maybe Gaia TV afterwards, and then and writing a book. And that was it. But yeah. Time for one more question. I've got like 15 other questions, at least, that I want to ask. But I mentioned the Archangels. So you had another visit. Not only did you meet your 11th dimensional family, but you also had the Archangels show up in your living room. (0:37:22)

Yeah, that was that that was a big surprise because once again, I was in my living room. I was watching TV. And then all of a sudden, this event happens when I could clearly and that was during the day. So I could see I had a 17 high foot ceiling in my living room. And I basically had big long windows with like fur covers and everything else was very beautiful, beautiful room. (0:37:53)

And all of a sudden, I could feel the energy change again, but a different way. This time, I was lying down on the sofa. And I was looking through to the window, towards the windows. And I could see those silhouettes forming to the point of being physical human beings showing up with like long white hair, piercing blue eyes, almost like ice blue. And they were wearing white robes. And one of them had a book in his hand, like a large book. And I was stunned. I didn't know what to do with it. (0:38:40)

And I remember being slightly scared. And I was on my sofa thinking, again, not logically, I was thinking if I stay on my sofa, and I don't really go anywhere, I'll be safe. (0:38:50)

How did you know? We're running low on time. But how did you know that they were Archangels? Did they say, I am Archangel Michael, I am Archangel Raphael? Yes, not right away. So when I first saw them, they didn't speak to me. There was no communication whatsoever. I could see them lining up next to me, like next to the in front of me, like on the in front of the bay window. (0:39:13)

And then the one of them walked towards me. And he was literally on the edge of the sofa, looking down at me. That's how close he was. So I could really see him very clearly. He had very like porcelain skin. Flawless. He was, he was ageless to me, I couldn't even date, say how old he was. And he was holding this book, and it was open in his hands. And he was not communicating with me, he was just like holding it just in front of me. (0:39:49)

And I felt compelled to put my hands underneath the book. So I literally went up there. And that's when I blacked out. Okay, I literally blacked out. And I was in space. I was traveling through space with Michael. So Archangel Michael was the guy who basically led me in and showed me Source. He showed me the beginning of the universe. He showed me, I felt that intense energy, like loving energy. (0:40:22)

At Source, I was there. And so this is where we all come from. And then from there, he was he was eager to show me the Pleiadian spaceship. After seeing like the Big Bang, like seeing all these planets formation through space and time, like I was going through the whole thing. And then I was going to the spaceship, and I could see the spacecraft from the outside, the outside at first, and I was going inside. And I could see the Pleiadians splicing the soul, because it was all connected to my experience. As a soul being, they were showing me that they were allowing those Pleiadians to splice the soul for knowledge, for experience. And that was allowed in the laws of the universe. (0:41:10)

And they were sending out those souls to different beings on different planetary systems, so they could learn from those beings. And I'm one of them as a human being today. So I'm a fraction of the soul from this Pleiadian that lives on that spaceship. And so my views of aliens and everything else changed radically, completely after that experience, because it changed my perspective. (0:41:54)

Which at the time was new, obviously, but I was able to have a much broader understanding of the universal experience. So my experiences with the ETs moving forward changed because I was no longer seeing them as superior than human beings and superior than me and trying to get a teaching from them. I was maybe sharing information, but it was on the same level. (0:42:22)

I was not feeling that I was talking to a god or anything else and any of the other species that I've interacted with. But to me, they were like, I understood where they came from, because I could relate to them on a soul level. (0:42:37)

Okay, Sébastien Martine. Wow, unbelievable story. And there's so much more. The name of the book is Inner Journey in Outer Space. And your website for everybody, Sébastien? I don't have a website. I'm sorry. Okay, I'm sorry. New show? En Suho, yes. I used to have a website, but it's never been functional. All right. So the book is Inner Journey in Outer Space. Check out Cosmic Disclosure. Just Google Sébastien. You'll find out so much more about him. You've been amazing. I invite you back right now to be my guest on Guys Guys Radio. There's so much more, so many questions I have, but thank you so much. Amazing, amazing, amazing story. (0:43:15)

Thank you so much for having me, Robert. Thank you. If you enjoy the guests and content I bring you each and every week to Guys Guys TV and Guys Guys Radio, please support us by subscribing to our channels and platforms. Thank you.

(0:43:27)

item.title: 船の周囲に巨大な回転する湾曲したスポーク模様 ⇒ この謎を解く
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

タイトルのような目撃事例の話はこれまでも何度か聞いてきたが、今回、上図を見て、この正体に思い当たった。

FasterWhisper AI(large-v2 model) + DeepL(2024-07 model)​

あなたが注目していることの一つは、多くのケースとは大きく異なるようです。少なくともあなたの説明によれば、事件の大部分は、何らかの諜報機関によって有人または操縦されている、ある種の工芸品のようです。しかし、非常に異なる目撃例があります。それは光である。その光は車輪から出るスポークの形をしている。 (0:11:54)

スポークが曲がっていることもある。あなたが主張するように、これは非常に異なっているようです。工芸品ではない。 ええ、これらのものが何であるかを知るのは難しいです。19世紀と20世紀のかなりの期間にかなり記録されています。実際、私が記録した最後のケースは1960年代のもので、おそらく70年代のものだと思う。しかし、そのほとんどは19世紀、1880年代、90年代、1900年代初頭に起こったものだ。100年前にチャールズ・フォートという研究者が、古い新聞記事などをたくさん集めました。 (0:12:40)

そしてそれらはとても珍しいものでした。通常、アラビア海やマラッカ海峡、南シナ海のような東の海で、船の船長が航海していました。そして、縁のない発光スポークという現象に気づくのです。縁はないのですが、このようなスポークが何百ヤードも続いているのです。スポークは中央のハブを中心に回転している。 (0:13:09)

水中では、これらは水の上にはなかった。この現象に気づいた船長は誰も、これが通常の燐光だと思わなかったようだ。これは違う。これらは水面下にあった。下から来ているように見え、人工的なものに見えた。自然現象には見えなかった。 (0:13:32)

しかし、誰もそれに関連する物体や工芸品のようなものに気がつきませんでした。 だから謎なのです。海の専門家の中には、これらはある種の自然な燐光であると主張する人もいると思いますが、私は真実をお伝えすることができます。私は専門家ではありませんが、これらの現象が自然のものであることを理解するのは非常に困難です。 (0:13:59)

そして、実際に再現されたことはない。つまり、再現しようとする試みはあったのですが、率直に言って成功したとは思えません。このような大規模なものではありません。だから謎なんだ。 チャールズ・フォートは100年前、彼らは人間ではない知的生命体だと考えていた。それに反論することはできませんが、私たちは工作機械を見ていません。 (0:14:21)

展開

One of the things that you focus on would seem to be very different from the bulk of the cases. The bulk of the cases, at least according to your description, would appear to be craft of some sort that are being manned or piloted by some intelligence. However, there's a category of sightings that are very different. They are lights. And the lights take the form of spokes coming out of a wheel. (0:11:54)

And sometimes the spokes are curved. And it would appear, I think you claim, this is very different. It's not a craft. Yeah, it's hard to know what these things are. They were recorded quite a bit in the 19th century and for a good portion of the 20th century. In fact, the last such case that I noted was one in the 1960s and I think one possibly in the 70s. But most of them were really in the 19th century, the 1880s and 90s and early 1900s. The researcher Charles Fort, a century ago, collected a lot of them, old newspaper accounts and the like. (0:12:40)

And they're very unusual. So what you would have is a ship's captain out, usually in the eastern seas, like the Arabian Sea or the Malacca Strait or the South China Sea. And they would note this phenomenon of these luminous spokes without a rim. There was no rim, but you would have these spokes and going out for often hundreds of yards. And they would be revolving around a central hub. (0:13:09)

Under the water, these were not on top of the water. None of the ship's captains who noted them seemed to think that they were normal phosphorescence, which of course does happen in the waters. This is different. These were below the water. They seemed like they were coming from below and they usually looked artificial. They did not look like natural phenomenon. (0:13:32)

But in no case did anyone notice like an object or a craft in connection to that. So it is a mystery. I know some ocean experts will argue that these were some kind of natural phosphorescence, but I can tell you the truth. I've looked at some of the academic studies on this and I'm no expert, but it's very difficult for me to understand how these could be natural. (0:13:59)

And they have not really been reproduced. I mean, there were attempts to do so, but I don't think that they succeeded, frankly. And certainly not on the scale that these things are. So it's a mystery. Charles Fort, looking into it, believed that they were a non-human intelligence writing a hundred years ago. And I can't really argue against that, but we haven't seen a craft. (0:14:21)

item.title: Robert Temple の 「UFO＝知性を持ったプラズマ」説
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

そんな説があったとは。「知性を持った」という点を除外すれば、私の主張に近いのだが。

FasterWhisper AI(large-v2 model) + DeepL(2024-07 model)​

1960年代のあるケースでは、この現象に関連した電磁気の影響がありました。そのため、実際の物体が下にあったかもしれないと考えることに少し自信が持てますが、それが何であるか実際に見たことはありません。 ロバート・テンプルが最近書いた『The New Science of Heaven（天国の新しい科学）』という本をご存知ですか？彼はプラズマ物理学のアイデアを研究し、UFOに関連する多くの現象がプラズマである可能性を示唆している。 (0:15:04)

それは興味深いアイデアだ。ロバート・テンプルはとても興味深い人物だ。これは確かに私の専門ではないので、ここで注意しなければならないのですが、プラズマやある種の光現象が知性を持って行動することは可能なのでしょうか？私たちのように有機的な脳を持つわけではないが、プラズマや光の玉のようなものに知的な作用があるということはあり得るのだろうか？私の全くの素人的なバックグラウンドからすると、こういったものの振る舞いを見ただけで可能だと思いたいのですが、それがどのように作用するのかはわかりません。 (0:15:53)

ロバート・テンプルは実際にそうであると確信している。彼はロシアのプラズマ物理学者の研究を引用して、自己分解について語り、テンプルによれば、プラズマ雲は、例えば人体よりもはるかに複雑で洗練された方法で自分自身を組織化する能力を持っているという。それは魅力的で、間違いなく追求する価値がある。実は、出版する前に、私は今この研究の第2巻を仕上げようとしている。今朝もそれに取り掛かっていたのだが、これらのコンセプトのいくつかを、この研究に関する私の最後の2冊の本のうちの1冊に組み込もうとするかもしれない。 (0:16:35)

世の中には、人間の脳では理解できないような奇妙なことが起こっているのかもしれない。その点については、全面的に同意する。私が見たUSOのケースの多くには、何らかの物体や工芸品、または固形物があるように見えるものがあります。 (0:17:06)

ほとんどがそうだ。しかし私は、他にもいくつかの可能性があることに同意せざるを得ません。そしてこのプラズマとのつながりは、確かにそのひとつだ。 (0:17:14)

展開

In one case in the 1960s, there was electromagnetic effects associated with this phenomenon. So that gives me a little more confidence to think that there might've been an actual object down there, but we've never really seen what it could be. Well, I wonder if you're familiar with the recent book by Robert Temple called The New Science of Heaven. He looks into the idea of plasma physics and suggests that many phenomenon associated with UFOs could be plasma, which would mean some form of matter that is not based on atoms or molecules, but actually ionic. (0:15:04)

That's an interesting idea. And Robert Temple's a very interesting man. I've often wondered if, this is certainly not my expertise, so I have to be careful here, but is it at all possible that a plasma or some kind of light phenomena can act with intelligence? It doesn't have an organic brain the way that we do, but can it be possible that there is intelligent action in something like a plasma or a ball of light? From my complete amateuristic background, I'm inclined to think it is possible just because of the behavior of some of these things, but I don't know how that would operate. (0:15:53)

Robert Temple is convinced that that is in fact the case, and he cites research from Russian plasma physicists who talk about autopolysis and how plasma clouds have the ability to organize themselves in a manner which is, according to Temple, much more complex and sophisticated than the human body, for example. Well, that's fascinating and definitely worth pursuing. Actually, before I publish, I'm actively finishing the second volume of this study right now. I was working on it this morning, and I may try to incorporate some of those concepts into one of my last two books on this. (0:16:35)

It may well be that there are things out there that are so strange that the human brain is just not capable of comprehending what's going on. I agree with you fully on that matter. There are a number of the USO cases that I have looked at, most of them, in which it does appear that there's some kind of object or craft or some solid, you know, you could knock on it and make a noise. (0:17:06)

That's the most of them. But I would have to agree that, you know, there are a couple of other possibilities out there, and they are important and they need to be looked into. And this plasma connection is certainly one. (0:17:14)

Some of the things you describe are really strange, like pillars of fire erupting from bodies of water, or I think in one case, a mountain. Yes, so there are some real outliers. There's a mountain. This one happened in 1963, just north of Puerto Rico. Now, Puerto Rico, many people might be aware, is a genuine hot spot of USO and UFO or UAP activity. (0:17:47)

item.title: 1963, プエルトリコ沖 : 海面が 800m 隆起するのを目撃したが影響は皆無 ⇒ この謎を解く
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

Richard Dolan の取り上げた事例。

FasterWhisper AI(large-v2 model) + DeepL(2024-07 model)​

あなたが説明していることのいくつかは本当に奇妙なものです。そうですね。 山です。これは1963年にプエルトリコのすぐ北で起きたものです。プエルトリコはUSOやUFO、UAPの活動で有名な場所です。 (0:17:47)

これは民間航空機のクルーが見たものだ。たしか、サンファンからニューヨークに向かって飛んでいた。彼らはプエルトリコ海溝の上空におり、その近くだったと思う。 (0:18:18)

そして彼らは、本質的に、これはクレイジーなことですが、つまり、海が半マイルほど隆起するのを見たのです。海から巨大な膨らみが出ている。このようなことは、島そのものに津波を引き起こしてもおかしくないと思うだろう。しかし、何も報告されていない。地震活動も記録されていない。奇妙な謎だ。 (0:18:43)

This one was seen by a commercial air crew. They were flying, I think, from San Juan to New York. They were above, near, I think, the Puerto Rico trench, which is a massively deep oceanic trench. (0:18:18)

And they saw, essentially, this is crazy, I mean, but they saw the ocean rise by something like half a mile. And there's this massive bulge out of the ocean. Something like that should have caused a kind of tsunami, you would think, on the island itself. And yet there was nothing reported. It would seem to be just too large, like there was no seismic activity recorded along with this. So that's a bizarre mystery. (0:18:43)

Youtube 動画(1:08:25)​

Unidentified Submerged Objects with Richard Dolan

この謎を解く​

可能性はふたつ。

  1. 蜃気楼

  2. 局所的に低く垂れ込めた雨雲

たぶん、下のような蜃気楼だろう。

ref: 海の駅「蜃気楼」｜富山県魚津市観光サイト｜周辺観光のご案内 http://www.shinkirou.jp/info.cgi
